reproduced_and_repaired_findings: Preheader abandonment during a blocked policy retained a viewer when its guard belonged to the blocking worker; guard now belongs to the async request.
Attachment cut could wait on Pending cancellation while cancellation policy waited for attachment headers; cut now takes the nonwaiting publication lock.
Digest byte bounds omitted JSON array brackets and commas; bounds now cover the entire serialized array.
Renewed policy could allow a stale view after a successor or generation change; ordinary view is reloaded after policy returns.
Read-only parked authority decoded sensitive rows after policy-triggered delete/recreate; post-authority ordinary reload now refuses before sensitive access.
Historical receipts accepted decisions at or after original expiry, or omitted consumed grant and audit pairs; full receipt/task history is validated.
An early current-policy mismatch hid later missing pending authority; all pending coverage is validated before healthy policy-change classification.
A faulted preterminal control was mistaken for inactive success; typed Faulted/Unavailable subscriptions now refuse while an already cached selected terminal survives late fault.
Native parked prompt equality could dump generated tokens on test failure; assertions now use static diagnostics.
Inactive verifier accepted retry before/after events, embedded or duplicate hints; strict state/standalone retry2000/Done ordering now has four permanent tests.
qualified_new_behaviors: Authenticated GET attachment reserves one immutable selected turn before policy waits and renews full origin, definition and stored identity without retargeting.
Bounded per-viewer frames and UTF-8 bytes; nonblocking overflow clears only that viewer and emits one detached frame; producer ownership and capacity persist.
Atomic native state cut and tail registration; whole-array bounded digest reports unavailable/truncated history honestly, including trusted recovered publication.
Inactive durable state, one standalone retry2000 and exact Done output null, including completed and parked actual SQLite reopen.
Read-only stable approval disclosure accepts prior stored owner and unchanged expired pending tokens only after renewed current authority and complete snapshot/grant/audit validation.
Existing non-detached live viewers keep exact cancellation terminal through drain and late fault; new drain viewers use inactive null Done; preterminal faults never fabricate completion.
Abandoned router future and actual preheader TCP request immediately release only the reserved viewer, including both held policy waits.
Capacity/snapshot/orphan/unregistered-definition refusals remain protected and healthy; attachment never dispatches or implicitly recovers work.
